officialTitle: Adjuvant vinorelbine plus cisplatin versus observation in patients with completely resected stage IB-IIIA non-small-cell lung cancer (Adjuvant Navelbine International Trialist Association [ANITA]): a randomised controlled trial

design.sampleSizeSourceQuote: 840 patients with stage IB-IIIA NSCLC from 101 centres in 14 countries were randomly assigned to observation (n=433) or to 30 mg/m(2) vinorelbine plus 100 mg/m(2) cisplatin (n=407).

clinicalQuestion: Does adjuvant vinorelbine plus cisplatin improve survival after complete resection of stage IB–IIIA NSCLC?

publications.title: Adjuvant vinorelbine plus cisplatin versus observation in patients with completely resected stage IB-IIIA non-small-cell lung cancer (Adjuvant Navelbine International Trialist Association [ANITA]): a randomised controlled trial.
publications.label: Primary analysis

outcomes.sourceQuote: After a median follow-up of 76 months (range 43-116), median survival was 65.7 months (95% CI 47.9-88.5) in the chemotherapy group and 43.7 (35.7-52.3) months in the observation group. Adjusted risk for death was significantly reduced in patients assigned chemotherapy compared with controls (hazard ratio 0.80 [95% CI 0.66-0.96]; p=0.017).

outcomes.endpointLabel: Absolute OS improvement at 5 years (8.6%) and 7 years (8.4%)
outcomes.sourceQuote: Overall survival at 5 years with chemotherapy improved by 8.6%, which was maintained at 7 years (8.4%).

safety.description: Neutropenia and febrile neutropenia in the chemotherapy group
safety.sourceQuote: Tolerance to chemotherapy mainly included neutropenia in 335 (92%) patients and febrile neutropenia in 34 (9%); seven (2%) toxic deaths were also recorded.

strengths: Randomised with OS primary endpoint and long follow-up
Single defined regimen with doses specified
limitations: Lower dose intensity for vinorelbine than cisplatin

clinicalImplications.text: Reinforced vinorelbine–cisplatin as an adjuvant standard after complete resection, with the benefit concentrated in node-positive and stage III disease according to subsequent analyses.

tumourBoardPearl.text: ANITA's regimen is the classic adjuvant vinorelbine–cisplatin schedule; dose intensity of vinorelbine was harder to maintain than that of cisplatin.

curation.notes: All numbers transcribed from the PubMed abstract of PMID 16945766.
